message:
feat(tactics): inject dependent payloads through checked equality transport

Build index-generalized type and value selectors, derive the actual type
equality, and retain casts in dependent field equations. Convertible
domains expose ordinary equality; heterogeneous payloads compose with
subst after their type equation is solved. Proof-family witness extraction
stays forbidden and dependent proof fields are not data injection goals.

Seven new source tests cover dependent packages, vector tails, alternative
constructors, heterogeneous transport, negative obligations and subsequent
contradiction. Installed CLI checks 11 commands and 7 theorems.
Local complete five-package tests, Clippy, workspace compilation and
formatting pass. Remote gates repeat before publication. No new axioms,
external dependencies, unsafe code or admission authority.
